name: Toyota Corolla (E210)
assembly: Blue Springs, Mississippi, United States (TMMMS, USDM models)
Burnaston, Derbyshire, United Kingdom (TMUK, hatchback and estate)
Toyota, Aichi, Japan (Takaoka and Tsutsumi plants, JDM models)

length.sourceNote: US-market SE/XSE saloon figure. The article publishes several saloon lengths by market: 4,495 mm (Japan), 4,630 mm (international base), 4,640 mm (China Levin) and others; this is the SE/XSE figure, matching the US trim recorded here.

width.sourceNote: International-market saloon width; the Japan-market saloon is narrower at 1,745 mm.

height.sourceNote: Published as a range for international-market saloons, 1,435-1,455 mm; lowest value in the range is recorded here per the site's convention. SE/XSE Apex is lower still at 1,420 mm; JDM/TREK is 1,460 mm.

wheelbase.sourceNote: Saloon/estate figure. The Japan-market hatchback rides a shorter 2,640 mm wheelbase.

kerbWeight.sourceNote: Published as a saloon range of 1,290-1,430 kg across trims and markets; lowest value in the range is recorded here per the site's convention.

trims.name: SE / XSE 2.0
trims.transmission: K120 CVT with physical first gear (6-speed manual, 2019-2023)

power.sourceNote: US-market SE/XSE figure, published as 169 hp (SAE net) at 6,600 rpm, converted at 1 hp = 0.745699872 kW.

torque.sourceNote: US-market SE/XSE figure, published as 151 lb-ft at 4,400 rpm, converted at 1 lb-ft = 1.355818 Nm.

fuelEconomy.sourceNote: EPA combined 34 mpg (US) for the 2020 2.0 L CVT car, converted at 235.215 L-mi/100km-gal.

co2.sourceNote: EPA tailpipe CO2, 257 g/mi, converted at 1.609344 km/mi. US test cycle only.

bootVolume.sourceNote: EPA saloon luggage volume, 13 cu ft, converted at 28.3168 L/cu ft. EPA's basis is not the European VDA method.

engine.configuration: inline-4, Atkinson cycle, Hybrid Synergy Drive

power.sourceNote: Hybrid system net output for the Hybrid LE, published as 121 hp (SAE net), converted at 1 hp = 0.745699872 kW. This is the combined system figure, not the petrol engine alone.

torque.sourceNote: Published as 105 lb-ft, converted at 1 lb-ft = 1.355818 Nm. The article does not separate engine and motor torque for this system, so no engine-only figure can be recorded.

hero.alt: White 2020 Toyota Corolla SE saloon photographed from the front three-quarter angle
hero.caption: The US-market 2020 Corolla SE, with the 2.0-litre Dynamic Force engine and 169 hp that replaced the old 1.8-litre base unit.
